reason: I’ll prepare the support ground first; a stable base seems useful before building the replacement support.
expectation: The excavator will probably level or clear the ground for a footing.

alternatives.reason: Combining steel and blocks could make part of the support, but preparing the ground seems a sensible first step.

effect: The ground is ready for a footing without disturbing the loaded cribbing; I can proceed with the support components.
reaction: Clearing around the loaded support feels physically sensible.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and steel and ceramic blocks seem useful for the replacement support.
expectation: I expect a footing or support component, though its exact form is unclear.

effect: The footing and braced frame are ready to place on the prepared ground.
reaction: The load-spreading plates make the construction feel sensible.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the prepared ground is where the footing belongs.
expectation: I expect the footing to be positioned on the firm ground, ready to support the lander.

effect: The replacement leg is assembled on the prepared footing; it now needs fastening to the lander.
reaction: The braced frame and fastening pins make the next step clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should connect the replacement support to the tilted lander.
expectation: I expect the leg to be secured to the sound joints, helping level the platform; the exact procedure is unclear.

effect: The replacement support carries the lander, and the chapter is complete; the leg will remain behind at launch.
reaction: The straight ladder is a satisfying callback to the damaged landing.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the leg was most worthwhile: the careful load transfer and straight ladder brought the landing problem to a concrete resolution.

leastWorthwhile.text: Seating the footing was the least engaging moment; it was a predictable transition with only one offered combination.

surprise.text: The finished leg stays on Mars when the upper cabin lifts away; that clarified its role as ground support rather than flight hardware.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The footing, bracing and careful avoidance of the loaded cribbing gave the sequence a clear physical purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The physically grounded repair and its connection to the original landing make me curious to see the return unfold, although most choices here were straightforward.
